other_conditions: Must have excellent communication, presentation, interpersonal and soft skills
Must be proficient in English and Hindi (reading, speaking, writing, understanding)
Must possess well‑versed ICT skills and knowledge of MS Office or similar applications
Must own a laptop and have a data card/internet facility

Must hold a post‑graduate qualification with minimum 60% marks or CGPA 6/10 in any stream from a recognized university, or be a graduate of Engineering/Medical/Law/CA/CS streams with the same minimum marks/CGPA
Preference is given to applicants with working experience in the field of the chosen department
benefits_summary: Stipend of ₹30,000 per month along with a monthly laptop connectivity support of ₹2,500 and 12 casual leaves per year.
